notes: *and so* is given whole to the waw under rule 55; marking *so* added under rule 30 remains defensible.

Corrected: *that bringeth* is no longer read as the construct relation's rendering. Rule 19 gives a rectum the relational *of* or a preposition the ASV recasts the relation with, while rule 20 rules that a supplied lexical participle inside a nominal recasting is added — *violence done to the land* leaves *done* added because it predicates an event rather than naming the thing. So אַשְׁמָה keeps *guilt* alone and the supplied relative and participle are their own added units.
The added pieces are kept apart under rule 2, the relative answering to rules 46 and 55 and the participle to rule 20; lumping them as one supplied relative frame is the near alternative.
